verdict.rationale: LM Studio ships an official `lms` CLI documented with commands for searching/downloading models (`lms get`), managing/loading models (`lms load`), interactive chat (`lms chat`), and server control (`lms server start/stop`), directly matching the story. Community evidence corroborates a headless/daemon mode being usable for real workflows, though no independent hands-on review specifically exercises the CLI's search/download/manage flow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the CLI commands themselves and any coverage of listing/removing already-downloaded models via CLI.
